integrity: Exact algebraic identities checked with reproducible rational code; all-time statements are established analytically; priority assessment limited to literature actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: Applies to well-mixed mean-field three-seed contests with f_i=kappa d_i, a unique positive kernel of the skew pairwise matrix, and interior starts. Does not apply to arbitrary nonproportional rates, finite stochastic populations or state-dependent feedback.
title: A sharp cumulative three-way contest exposure criterion for coexistence under proportional demographic heterogeneity
